|              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                              |
|              | The government has announced a large increase in energy prices for businesses, pre-announced a major reform to residential tariffs starting next year and have just declared the establishment of a new, independent energy regulator. | *<https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2023/10/13/uzbekistan-to-cut-fossil-fuel-subsidies-and-reduce-emissions-with-support-from-the-world-bank> : The government of Uzbekistan and the World Bank have signed a \$46.25 million agreement during the 2023 World Bank Group and International Monetary Fund Annual Meetings in Marrakech, Morocco. The funds will be allocated for the Innovative Carbon Resource Application for Energy Transition Project (iCRAFT), which supports Uzbekistan's clean energy transition, energy efficiency, and energy subsidy reforms. The iCRAFT Project, financed by the World Bank’s Transformative Carbon Asset Facility (TCAF), marks the Bank's inaugural initiative globally to aid policy reforms through payments for emission reductions. It aims to support Uzbekistan in meeting international climate commitments and enhancing energy resource efficiency, serving as a potential model for similar initiatives worldwide.* | Uzbekistan Country Climate and Development Report (2024)                                                                                                                     |
